title: SizePrompt

external_id.description: A user-configured identifier for this object within the menu. External IDs must be unique across all menu entities of this type. Any size prompt that shares this `external_id` will be overwritten.

name.description: The display name for this size prompt, which in this case is the prompt given to the diner.

internal_name.description: A name displayed on Grubhub menu management tools instead of the display name.

sized_prices.description: Additional price information about size within a normalized menu. For use in Size Prompts for the item pricing model.

description: Information about item sizing, including display text and pricing.

price.description: The price for the referenced Size for a given OrderServiceType.

NormalizedSizedPriceFulfillmentTypeSetti.description: SizedPriceFulfillmentTypeSettings include configurations to be used for a SizedPrice onlyfor one OrderServiceType.

calorie_content.description: Number of calories for the size.

display_name.description: Optional. If present, overrides the name of the referenced size, for display to diners.

fulfillment_type_settings.description: OrderServiceType-specific configurations for this SizedPrice. All keys should be strings representing order-service types (valid options include "STANDARD_DELIVERY", "STANDARD_PICKUP", "CATERING_DELIVERY", and "GROUP_DELIVERY". All values should be of type NormalizedSizedPriceFulfillmentTypeSettings.

SizedPrice.description: Additional price information about size within a normalized menu. For use in Size Prompts for the item pricing model.
